planets.name: LHS 1815 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of LHS 1815 with a 3.81-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: LHS 1815 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around LHS 1815. Its orbit and size follow Gan et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.

quotes.title: LHS 1815 b
quotes.card: LHS 1815 b is a thick disk exoplanet discovered in 2020 by TESS.
quotes.introduction: The planet is located outside the galactic plane.
